external_cross_check.what: Frame decode of a real 5-frame diaPASEF run by the independent timsrust 0.4.1 decoder and by this port (ruzstd 0.8.2, decoder identical to 0.8.1): 291,531 peaks, zero mismatches in frame, scan, TOF and corrected intensity.
external_cross_check.note: Recorded, not re-verified by the in-repo gate.

external_reference_note: The F5 oracle driver, its build-and-run script and its case generator live outside this repository under ../oracle/F5-xmass/ so that no C++ is committed here; built on ibminode06 against the Linux x86_64 Release install /ceph/ibmi/abi/oliver/opt/openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576, every case run twice in fresh processes with identical output. Recorded, not re-verified by the in-repo gate.
evidence: Tier 1 for PASEFHillCentroider (bit-identical to the executed Release build); tier 3 for the class-test sections of RationalScan2ImConverter, BrukerTimsImagingFile and PASEFHillCentroider; tier 4 for the synthetic-TDF BrukerTimsFile tests, whose expected values come from the opentims formulas; external tier-2-style cross-check of the frame decoder against timsrust.
gaps: BrukerTimsFile: loadDDA_ (SPECTRUM export and AUTO on DDA data), frame aggregation, Greedy2D centroiding (and dia_ms2_centroid), the Bruker SDK calibration, readDIAMetadata/loadDIAStreaming; each is Error::Unsupported.
